user.title: Link Phoenix
user.description: Generate a connection code in your Phoenix console → Home Assistant. It expires after ten minutes. Choose exposed devices in Home Assistant → Settings → Voice assistants → Expose. Self-hosted servers need a trusted HTTPS certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Relink Phoenix
reauth_confirm.description: Generate a connection code in your Phoenix console → Home Assistant. It expires after ten minutes. Choose exposed devices in Home Assistant → Settings → Voice assistants → Expose. Self-hosted servers need a trusted HTTPS certificate.

reconfigure.title: Change Phoenix connection
reconfigure.description: Generate a connection code in your Phoenix console → Home Assistant. It expires after ten minutes. Choose exposed devices in Home Assistant → Settings → Voice assistants → Expose. Self-hosted servers need a trusted HTTPS certificate.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS server origin without a path, username, query, or fragment.
error.invalid_code: This code is expired, already used, or invalid. Generate a new code in Phoenix.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Phoenix. Check the server URL and connection. If a code may have been used, disconnect that installation in Phoenix and generate a new code.
error.rate_limited: Too many linking attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and generate a new code.
error.already_linked: A selected Jibo is already linked. Disconnect its old installation in Phoenix first.
error.unsupported_protocol: This Phoenix server uses an unsupported connector protocol. Update Phoenix and this integration.

init.title: Jibo voice settings
init.description: Choose the conversation agent for Jibo home commands. Assign each Jibo device to an area in Home Assistant for room context. Enable announcements separately in the Phoenix console; they use Jibo's current master volume. Quiet hours use Home Assistant's time zone and may cross midnight. Add an exact routine phrase and an Assist-exposed scene or script; reopen these settings to add another phrase. Routines are reported as started, without claiming their resulting device states.

error.invalid_shortcut: Choose a unique phrase of up to 80 characters and a scene or script. Ordinary Jibo commands are reserved. You can save up to 16 phrases; their combined size must fit one connector message.
error.shortcut_not_exposed: Expose this scene or script to Assist before adding a routine phrase.
error.invalid_quiet_hours: Choose valid start and end times for quiet hours.

invalid_message.message: Use a nonempty plain-text announcement of up to 300 characters.

unsupported_title.message: Jibo announcements accept a message without a title.

disconnected.message: Phoenix is disconnected. This announcement was not queued.

unsupported_announcements.message: This Phoenix server does not support Jibo announcements.

unsupported_robot_announcements.message: Jibo announcements need the native receiver in BE 13.1.1 or later. Room context, home commands, and questions can still use this connection.

permission_denied.message: Enable announcements for this installation in the Phoenix console.

quiet_hours.message: Quiet hours are active. This announcement was not sent or queued.

robot_offline.message: Jibo is offline. This announcement was not queued.

robot_busy.message: Jibo is busy. This announcement was not queued.

announcement_expired.message: The announcement expired before it could be spoken.

confirmation_lost.message: Phoenix could not confirm that Jibo finished speaking. The announcement will not be retried.

announcement_failed.message: Jibo could not complete the announcement. It will not be retried.
